programme.title: Our House
programme.desc: March 25, 2006 Ruth Galloway is a well-to-do socialite who's not quite as secure inside as she seems from the outside. When a young woman named Billy saves her life, Ruth decides to turn her mansion into a shelter for the city's homeless.

programme.title: When Duty Calls
programme.desc: Newlyweds Ellie and Martin move in with her parents while she waits for a job on the local police force. Their relationship is strained when Ellie, who had been working to solve a string of robberies, learns that Martin has been offered a job in Maine.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: A man and a woman agree to meet after hitting it off on a phone call, but they keep missing each other for various reasons.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Sentimental tale of a proud widow (Ann-Margret) whose deteriorating sight impels her to take in a drifter (Matthew Settle) and his precocious daughter (Shailene Woodley). Gary Sandy, Hunter Tylo. Jan Kyles: Rebecca McFarland. Dave Jeeters: Sean O'Bryan. Sheriff Gorman: Christopher Murray.

programme.title: Oliver's Ghost
programme.desc: A young boy (Nicholas Stargel) befriends a ghost (Martin Mull) living in the attic of his family's new house in a small town. After several angry outbursts from the ghost, the boy tries to get to the bottom of what's plaguing him. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Vickery's Wild Ride
programme.desc: A successful ad man (Jonathan Silverman) tries to reconnect with his family by taking them on a monthlong vacation to a rustic cabin that he recently inherited. Though resistant at first, the family start to enjoy themselves after meeting a cowboy (Peter Strauss) who teaches them about life's simpler pleasures.

programme.title: Bound & Babysitting
programme.desc: A couple need a babysitter so they can go on a much-needed romantic getaway, so they enlist the help of two friends who have been enemies since college in hopes that they realize how much they have in common.

programme.title: Mechanics of Love
programme.desc: Mattie, a tech entrepreneur who is home for her sisters wedding runs into Jake, a childhood friend who complicates her life.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: In this sequel, the use of land abutting the wilderness sparks conflict for Fog (who owns the land) and Jack. Rather than drill for oil, Fog says he'll open a natural spring-water business, but Jack doesn't believe him, and ends up being jailed for sabotaging the operation.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: A troubled young mother pins her hopes on winning an equestrian event after her husband leaves her to raise their daughter alone.

programme.title: Reluctant Nanny
programme.desc: A lone officer desperately seeks a nanny for two children awaiting foster care, while Libby, jobless in LA, grapples with her future. Their paths cross due to a petty theft.

programme.title: The Michaels
programme.desc: A manicurist predicts that an unlucky-at-love lawyer will meet the love of her life and he will be a Michael, so the attorney begins a series of dates with men with that name.

programme.title: Love on the Vines
programme.desc: A young lawyer works for six weeks at a vineyard to inherit it.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: Generation Gap
programme.desc: A rebellious teen (Alex Black) reluctantly spends the summer with his strict war-veteran grandfather (Ed Asner). While the two clash at first, they soon bring about positive changes in each other that lead to new friendships and experiences. Rue McClanahan, Catherine Mary Stewart, Ralph Waite. Directed by Bill L. Norton.

programme.title: Mechanics of Love
programme.desc: Mattie, a tech entrepreneur who is home for her sisters wedding runs into Jake, a childhood friend who complicates her life.

Ex-CIA agent Lucas Reyes is tasked with boarding an international flight in order to identify and apprehend a mysterious hacker. However, the job grows infinitely more complicated when Reyes realises the plane is stuffed with assassins all battling to take down his target - and kill him in the process.

programme.title: One More Shot
programme.desc: A Navy SEAL squad leader escorts a suspected terrorist from a black site when they come under fire from a group of mercenaries. Director James Nunn's thriller, starring Scott Adkins, Alexis Knapp and Tom Berenger.

programme.title: The Dry
programme.desc: Federal agent Aaron Falk returns to his drought-stricken home town after an absence of more than 20 years to attend the funeral of his childhood friend. But his arrival opens up a decades-old wound - the unsolved death of a teenage girl. Crime drama, starring Eric Bana and Genevieve O'Reilly.

programme.title: Force of Nature: The Dry 2
programme.desc: Five women participate in a hiking retreat, but only four come out the other side. Federal agents Aaron Falk and Carmen Cooper head into the mountains hoping to find their informant still alive. Thriller, starring Eric Bana, Anna Torv and Deborra-Lee Furness.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jonah Hill and Michael Cera as Seth and Evan, two boys bonded by their lack of popularity. When the pair finally get invited to a party they embark on a quest to procure alcohol in the hope that it will not only lay to rest their geeky reputation but also improve their chances with the opposite sex.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Black comedy starring Jason Bateman, Charlie Day and Jason Sudeikis. Three downtrodden, demoralised workers decide enough is enough and hatch a plan to kill each other's bosses. They seek advice from an ex-con, but devising the perfect crime proves trickier than expected.

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Tom Hanks. A tense stand-off ensues between Captain Richard Phillips and Muse, the leader of Somali pirates who hijack his container ship. But both men are also subjected to outside political forces.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: War drama based on real events, starring Josh Hartnett, Ewan McGregor and Tom Sizemore. On 3 October 1993, elite US troops were sent into Somalia's capital, Mogadishu, to capture two lieutenants working for the local warlord responsible for orchestrating a famine in the region. The ensuing 15-hour battle saw the deaths of nearly 20 American soldiers, and hundreds of Somalis, after two Black Hawk helicopters were shot down.

programme.desc: Four friends come together for a birthday celebration, but as the night progresses secrets emerge and unsettling events unfold. Thriller with Catalina Sandino Moreno.

programme.title: Public Enemies
programme.desc: Tommy gun-toting bank robber Johnny Depp is hunted down by FBI man Christian Bale. Dazzling Depression-era gangster epic from Michael Mann. Strong violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Last Seen Alive
programme.desc: When his estranged wife disappears at a petrol station, Will embarks on a frantic mission to find her before the police find him. Sky Original film starring Gerard Butler.

programme.title: Maggie Moore(s)
programme.desc: A police chief investigates the bizarre murders of two women with the same name and unravels a web of small-town lies. Sky Original comedy thriller with Jon Hamm.

programme.title: The Bikeriders
programme.desc: Over a decade, a motorcycle club evolves from a gathering of local outsiders to a sinister gang. Drama starring Tom Hardy and Jodie Comer.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Playboy Tom Cruise's new romance with dancer Penelope Cruz is ruined by crazed lover Cameron Diaz in this mindbending mystery. Contains strong language/sex/flashing images.

programme.title: Sleepers
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars in the true story of the men who took revenge on the prison guards who abused them as kids. Intense drama. Strong language/violence/sex/mature themes.
